name: zt-econ-digest
description: Digest a Chinese-translated economics book into ZET Cards: the ZT digest base with the economics set: the model layer (Model Cards in the digest, the model compiler with the economic architect), the event layer (Event Cards from the book's dated sentences), the empirical-results layer (Finding Cards, one per result), and the economics prompts
whenToUse: Turn a Scholar Archive economics book (Chinese bilingual Markdown, digested as Chinese only) into an agent Literature tree plus Topic trees, with Idea, Event, and Model Cards (economic models at concept or formal level). Modes link, models, cards, explain, hubs, figures, and audit re-run single stages on an existing digest.

preflight.P1: Goal and result: the book digest of the removed zt-book-digest.js for economics books, on the framework, with the economics layers as its own module set. The result is the base result with the model reports, events: {...}, and findings: {...}. The base 2.1.2 adds the Bridge report and isolated apply mode.
preflight.P2: Inputs: the base args plus events and findings (false skips that layer). Base Bridge arguments are inherited; base 2.4.0 adds args.book, the Scholar Archive Work id or title that resolves the book.
preflight.P3: Units of work: as the base, plus the Model Cards of the book (model layer), the dated sentences per group (event layer), and the sentences that report data with a number per group (empirical-results layer; 3 groups per DeepSeek job each).
preflight.P4: Roles: as the base (manager Haiku low, architect Sonnet, organizer Opus).
preflight.P5: Stage graph: args → source → prepare → [after-prepare] → terms → concepts → digest → cards → [after-digest: models] → [after-models: explain] → cards-book → review → link-prepare → link → link-check → [after-link] → organize → figures → bridge → hubs (then the register plan) → audit → finalize → cleanup → report The order is the dependency flow of §13.1 on the existing stages: terms and the frozen concept review of the term table precede the group writers, the scoped restatement review precedes the gap-only Link pass, the report-first Bridge precedes the hub and register plan, and the finite finalization and its read-only audit stay last. the Event and Finding layers fill after-terms, so they are worked from ledger readiness while the remaining digest groups run and while the concept review of the term table settles; after-digest: the model layer, released when the digest managers settle; after-models: explanations of the finished Derivation parts, which settle before the link pass; the whole-book card cycle waits for the Model reviews; then the scoped restatement review, Figures → Bridge → Hubs, and the final audit joins Hubs and Bridge. Bridge profile book. A resume and the repair modes drain the tail that their own layer released: modes models, explain, events and findings run their layer, the changed-Card Link pass and check, Organize, the touched Hubs, the audit and the settlement, and mode resume adds the concept review, the restatement review and the finalization (#87, R283/R286, S23).
preflight.P6: Modules (the economics set): the profile (dsh-digest-base.zh.md plus dsh-model-cards.zh.md: the digest writes Idea Cards and Model Cards; shared-prefix.md, link-prefix.md; the economic architect model-architect.md), zt-model-layer and zt-explain (zt-model-lib), zt-event-layer (event-compiler.ps1, dsh-event-instructions.zh.md), zt-finding-layer (finding-compiler.ps1, dsh-finding-instructions.zh.md; the Card type finding of zt 0.20.0). zt-bridge v3.
preflight.P7: Checks: as the base; each event and finding job runs its SELF-CHECK (precheck: fields, supported Cards, and zt-check on the drafts: E1, E2 or F1 to F3, and the Card language); apply refuses what the precheck reports; in mode full the link check card cycle then checks every Card of the book. Bridge BR1–BR9, exact report acceptance and guarded edits.
preflight.P8: Failure policy: as the base; the model layer halts only in mode models; the event and finding layers report refused items and go on. Modes: the base modes plus models, explain, events, findings. Bridge failure is nonfatal in full; bridge apply runs only args, Bridge and report. Mode resume accepts only out and spends the one supported resume; the repair modes keep their own layers and drain their dependent outputs instead of rebuilding unrelated groups or models (#87, R286).
preflight.P9: Dry run: zt-econ-digest.sim.json. Fixture: tests/framework-harness.mjs checks the readiness graph, the ledger commands of the group cycle and every layer, the runner restrictions and the joins on the built script; tests/event-compiler.tests.ps1 and tests/finding-compiler.tests.ps1 use scratch archives. Run with zt 0.20.0 deployed. Pilot: one chapter after a database backup. 4.4.1: rebuilt with the DeepSeek Subagent Managed Protocol v1.1 block (2026-10-18: managers start runs with wait_seconds 0, poll all open sessions, collect and delete at once, block on one session for at most pollSeconds, cancel after budgetMinutes); no stage, data-flow, param or role change. 5.11.0: built on the base 4.11.0 Tree Lock seam (zt-digest-lib v31, zt-digest-prepare v10), so preparation and every writing stage stop with the archive's typed `card_locked` refusal and keep their drafts and receipts (#140).

events.description: mode full: false skips the event layer

findings.description: mode full: false skips the empirical-results layer

after-terms.title: Events
after-terms.detail: the event layer: event-compiler.ps1 lists the dated sentences and each group's Idea Cards; DeepSeek writes the Event Cards as JSON with its SELF-CHECK; the script creates them beside the Idea Cards they support and links them

after-terms.title: Findings
after-terms.detail: the empirical-results layer: finding-compiler.ps1 lists the sentences that report data with a number and each group's Idea Cards; DeepSeek writes one Finding Card per result as JSON with its SELF-CHECK (F1 to F3); the script creates them beside the group anchors and links them with 印证

after-digest.title: Models
after-digest.detail: the model layer: the model compiler on every Model Card of the book (DeepSeek brief → Sonnet plan → DeepSeek fill, derive, review, split)

after-models.title: Models
after-models.detail: mode explain: 思路, 说明, and 解读 for finished Derivation parts
